snippet.title: Super Battle Golf | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Super Battle Golf is an online 1-8 player golf game where everyone plays at the same time, launching on Steam February 19th! Swing, shoot, sabotage, and finish first by any means necessary in a free-for-all rush to the hole. 

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4069520/Super_Battle_Golf/
